detailed_description:
The target video is cinematic live-action with a high-contrast neon-and-rain atmosphere, fluid martial-arts choreography, and rapid but readable cuts.
[Shot 1] A medium-wide shot frames <Subject 1> and <Subject 2> facing each other in a rain-slicked neon alley at night. <Subject 1>, the cyberpunk warrior with short black hair and blue streaks, wears her black-and-red armored bodysuit with silver shoulder plates and a translucent hooded cape. <Subject 2>, the ancient-Chinese swordswoman with a long black high ponytail, wears a black martial robe with white inner lining and grips her sword in a raised guard. The camera holds a static shot as <Subject 1> lunges forward and swings a glowing energy blade downward; <Subject 2> raises her sword in a defensive block, sparks scattering where the blades meet.
[Shot 2] At 00:02.000, the camera cuts to a tracking shot following <Subject 1> as she presses the attack with two fast consecutive slashes. <Subject 2> moves in a guard-first style, sidestepping with her blade angled to deflect each strike, then drops into a low backward step that keeps her sword firmly between them, reading as a controlled defensive counter rather than a retreat.
[Shot 3] At 00:04.500, the shot switches to a wide shot as <Subject 2> pushes off the ground and leaps backward in a high arc, landing lightly on the edge of a rain-soaked rooftop with the neon city skyline behind her. The camera tracks upward and across to the rooftop, where <Subject 1> vaults up after her and lands in a combat crouch, cape whipping in the wind.
[Shot 4] At 00:06.500, the camera cuts to a close-up of the rooftop duel: <Subject 2> drops into a one-knee defensive stance, sword raised to guard, while <Subject 1> launches a diving forward strike. Their weapons clash in mid-air, faces inches apart, rain blasting off the blades. The camera shakes slightly with large amplitude at fast speed on impact, then holds on the locked-blade freeze against the city lights.

overall_soundscape:
Heavy rain hits the wet pavement and rooftop throughout the scene. Boots splash through puddles, fabric whips through the air, and metal blades ring and scrape with each block and strike. A sharp impact thud punctuates the final rooftop weapon lock.
